profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as offering a "Revenue AI OS," a platform it says helps go-to-market organizations close deals, predict pipeline risk, automate handoffs, and reduce churn through what it calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built applications.

Gong's core product, tracked under the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, centers on revenue intelligence AI with capabilities including call analysis and deal coaching. The platform includes named components such as Gong Engage, described as a sales engagement tool, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer feature the company says allows teams to build training from their own customer conversations. One customer quoted on the site reported saving 6,700 hours across call prep, follow-up, and CRM updates, and attributed a 32 percent lift in buyer response rates to Gong's AI Tracker agent.

The held facts note 161 cases of legal exposure associated with California, and the product profile flags sensitive sales data exposure as a consideration alongside the platform's core features. Three MCP server entries are associated with the Gong name in the registry, two related to SQLite database exploration and one unrelated to Gong's business, suggesting the name overlap is coincidental rather than reflecting official Gong products.
